claim: On February 25th, 2027 AWS X-Ray will discontinue support for the AWS X-Ray SDKs and Daemon; AWS recommends migrating to OpenTelemetry. The X-Ray service itself is not retired.
question: When does AWS end support for the X-Ray SDKs and the X-Ray daemon?
note: The support timeline page lists only the maintenance phase from February 25th, 2026; the end-of-support date comes from the document history notice. Older practice questions still say 'install the X-Ray daemon / SDK'.
